author: Top Gear
description:
This is a new Bugatti Veyron! Known officially as the FKP Hommage – after Ferdinand Karl Piëch, the man who revived the defunct Bugatti brand in the 1990s – it’s a retro-inspired, one-of-one creation celebrating two decades of the Veyron hypercar.

🚗 Bugatti Veyron FKP Hommage
